verdict.rationale: Official docs confirm a real CLI package (`@arizeai/phoenix-cli`) invoked via `npx -y @arizeai/phoenix-cli setup` to auto-configure tracing, and `uvx arize-phoenix serve` to launch the server, showing genuine CLI tooling exists. However, evidence only covers setup/launch use cases, not a full-featured CLI for managing datasets, experiments, or prompts, so its scope for agentic/CLI-driven workflows appears limited.
